{{Top|leg}}
The '''antidote''' for the [[Bordal Contagion]] disease was created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tauber]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]]. [[Kett Shipping]], as well as other companies, sent [[Convoy/Legends|convoys]] to collect and deliver the [[Antidote/Legends|antidote]] to the infected [[Bordal]]i, but the [[Fujari]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] intercepted and ruined six million doses of it. Eventually, however, the [[Rseikharhl]] set up their own labs to manufacture the antidote, but the delay cost millions of lives on Bordal.<ref name="EGtW:AC">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-6-showdown-at-naboo|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 6: Showdown at Naboo}}</ref>
